cases.exposure_context_quote: admitted to the hospital following suicidal ingestion of an unknown quantity of "Sackweed-38," which contains 38% ethyl ester (2,4-D)
cases.agent: 'Sackweed-38' containing 38% ethyl ester (2,4-Dichlorophenoxyacetic acid), unknown quantity
cases.agent_quote: suicidal ingestion of an unknown quantity of "Sackweed-38," which contains 38% ethyl ester (2,4-D)
cases.circumstance: suicidal ingestion; initial treatment at a nearby hospital then transferred, presenting to the emergency department approximately six hours after ingestion

symptoms.finding: vomiting, diarrhea, progressively worsening altered sensorium
symptoms.quote: she had a few episodes of vomiting and diarrhea and developed an altered sensorium, which progressively worsened

symptoms.finding: coma (GCS E1VTM1) with pinpoint nonreactive pupils
symptoms.quote: she had a Glasgow Coma Score (GCS) of E1VTM1 and had pinpoint and nonreactive bilateral pupils
Neuromuscular symptoms of twitching, fasciculations, and hypotonia were noted, and an electroencephalogram ruled out seizure activity.

symptoms.finding: severe esophagitis with blood clots in the stomach on endoscopy
symptoms.quote: Emergent endoscopy revealed severe esophagitis with blood clots in the stomach.

cases.time_to_care: presented to our emergency department after approximately six hours of poison ingestion

labs.name: arterial blood gas
labs.quote: Metabolic acidosis was seen on an arterial blood gas analysis.

labs.name: fingerstick glucose
labs.quote: temperature of 98.6°F, and fingerstick glucose of 310 mg/dL

labs.name: blood 2,4-D level
labs.quote: Blood levels of 2,4-D could not be measured due to the non-availability of this test at our facility.

treatment.name: intubation for airway protection and gastric lavage
treatment.quote: She required intubation for airway protection, gastric lavage was performed, and she received intravenous fluids and needed initiation of vasopressors for management of hypotension.

treatment.name: norepinephrine and vasopressin (dual vasopressor support)
treatment.quote: a blood pressure of 108/77 mmHg on norepinephrine and vasopressin support

treatment.name: alkaline diuresis with injectable sodium bicarbonate
treatment.quote: She underwent alkaline diuresis with injectable sodium bicarbonate and maintained a urine output of 200 ml/hr.

treatment.name: pantoprazole infusion and potassium supplementation
treatment.quote: Other treatment measures included initiation of pantoprazole infusion and potassium supplementation for hypokalemia management.

treatment.name: polymyxin B, ceftriaxone-sulbactam, and fluconazole for multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae and yeast
treatment.quote: She received polymyxin B, ceftriaxone-sulbactam, and fluconazole based on the culture sensitivity results.

cases.icu_admission: yes (implied by intubation, mechanical ventilation, vasopressors)
cases.outcome: died of cardiac arrest on the sixth day of hospitalization
cases.outcome_quote: Unfortunately, she had a cardiac arrest and passed away on the sixth day of hospitalization.
cases.notes: Refractory hypotension, worsening renal failure, metabolic acidosis, hypernatremia and hyperkalemia throughout hospitalization; ventilator-associated pneumonia with multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae.
